definitions.gloss: conditional; with conditions; with strings attached
definitions.explanation: Describes something that is granted or valid only under certain conditions or restrictions, not unconditionally.

examples.japanese: {条件付|じょうけんつ}きの{許可|きょか}が{出|で}た。
{条件付|じょうけんつ}きで{採用|さいよう}が{決|き}まった。
examples.english: The hiring was decided with conditions attached.

examples.japanese: この{契約|けいやく}は{条件付|じょうけんつ}きなので、すべての{項目|こうもく}をよく{確認|かくにん}してから{署名|しょめい}してください。
examples.english: This contract is conditional, so please review all items carefully before signing.

notes:
Compound of {条件|じょうけん} (condition) + {付|つ}き (attached, with). Indicates that something comes with restrictions or requirements. Common in legal, business, and administrative contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {条件付|じょうけんつ}きの{承認|しょうにん} (conditional approval)
- {条件付|じょうけんつ}きで{賛成|さんせい}する (to agree with conditions)
- {条件付|じょうけんつ}きの{釈放|しゃくほう} (conditional release)
- {条件付|じょうけんつ}き{採用|さいよう} (conditional hiring)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {条件付|じょうけんつ}きの + noun (conditional ~)
- {条件付|じょうけんつ}きで (conditionally, with conditions)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {無条件|むじょうけん}: unconditional
- {条件|じょうけん}なし: without conditions (casual)

THE 〜{付|つ}き PATTERN:
The suffix {付|つ}き (with, included) is productive:
- {朝食付|ちょうしょくつ}き (with breakfast included)
- {送料込|そうりょうこ}み (shipping included — similar concept)
